3. Police after investigation submitted charge-sheet under sections. 143/323/324/375/307 of the Penal Code read with section 3 of the Explosive Substances Act against the accused appellant and 8 others. 

 6. The learned Advocate for the appellant submits that on the self-same offence another charge-sheet has been submitted under sections 143/324/326/379 and 307 of the Penal Code which is still pending in the court of the CMM Khulna. In that case also the accused appellant has been granted bail. He submits that accused appellant voluntarily surrendered and was granted bail and was on bail till it was cancelled on 6-4-96. He submits that there was no allegation against the accused appellant that he ever misused the privilege granted to him. He submits that there is no certainty when the trial shall conclude and furthermore the offence alleged against him does not come within the mischief under section 3 of the Explosive Substances Act.
